defense_contracts.raw_text: Burlington Industries LLC, Charlotte, North Carolina, has been awarded a maximum $224,373,811 fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for serge, elastique, tropical, heather charcoal and dark blue cloth. This was a competitive acquisition with one response received. This is a five-year contract with no option periods. The ordering period end date is Nov. 9, 2031. Using military services are Air Force and Space Force. Type of appropriation is fiscal 2027 through 2032 defense working capital funds. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Troop Support Philadelphia, PA (SPE1C1-27-D-0003).

Systems Planning and Analysis (SPA), Inc., Alexandria, Virginia, is awarded a $55,670,496 cost-plus-fixed-fee term task order (N0003027F3024) for Trident II Strategic Weapons System (SWS) support. This value includes optional line items, if exercised. Tasks to be performed include technical assessments, and studies, systems engineering and analysis support, and program integration and schedule support. Work will be performed in Washington, D.C. (60%); Alexandria, Virginia (32%); Bangor, Washington (1%); Denver, Colorado (1%); Titusville, Florida (1%); Kings Bay, Georgia (1%); Pittsfield, Massachusetts (1%); Valley Forge, Pennsylvania (1%); Magna, Utah (1%); and Sunnyvale, California (1%). Work is expected to be completed on Sep. 30, 2031. Fiscal 2026 research, development, test and evaluation funds in the amount of $200,981; fiscal 2027 research, development, test and evaluation funds in the amount of $150,000; and fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance, Navy funds in the amount of $1,348,216, will be obligated on this award. Funding in the amount of $200,981 will expire at the end of fiscal 2027. This contract also benefits a Foreign Military Sale to the United Kingdom. This task order will be awarded as a sole source acquisition with the authority of 15 U.S. Code 638 Research and Development. Portfolio Acquisition Executive, Strategic Systems Programs, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity.

Space Exploration Technologies Corp., Hawthorne, California, has been awarded a $9,921,992 broad agency announcement contract, with options for up to a maximum $12,666,379, for a risk reduction study on their Plug and Play Laser, also known as Plaser. This contract provides for the risk reduction study, the delivery of representative hardware, and support to missile warning and tracking system integration. Work will be performed in Hawthorne, California; and Redmond, Washington, and is expected to be completed by Oct. 7, 2027. This contract was a competitive acquisition. Since proposals are received throughout the year under the Systems, Technologies, and Emerging Capabilities Broad Agency Announcement, the number of proposals received in response to the solicitation is unknown. Fiscal 2026 research, development, test, and evaluation funds in the amount of $9,921,992 are being obligated at the time of award. The Space Development Agency, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity (FA240127C0001). (Awarded on Nov. 9, 2026).

Numunu Martinez JV, Lawton, Oklahoma, is awarded a $14,637,787 firm-fixed-price contract for the Atlantic Undersea Test and Evaluation Center (AUTEC) ground water storage tanks replacement. This contract provides for the replacement of two 500,000-gallon ground potable water storage tanks and associated infrastructure. Work will be performed at the AUTEC Main Base, Andros Island, Bahamas, and is expected to be completed by January 2028. The maximum dollar value, including the base period and zero option years, is $14,637,787. Fiscal 2026 research, development, test, and evaluation (Navy) funds in the amount of $14,637,787 will be obligated at time of award and will expire at the end of the current fiscal year. This contract was not competitively procured via SAM.gov; it is a sole-source award to an eligible 8(a) Tribal Joint Venture pursuant to 15 U.S. Code 637(a) and FAR 19.805-1(b)(2) (or 10 U.S. Code 3204(a)(5)). The Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command Southeast, Jacksonville, Florida (serviced by ROICC Space Coast, Cape Canaveral, Florida), is the contracting activity (N6945027C0004).
